items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: one night he saw the music stands and they said CB on there, he came out and said, “Charlie Barnet!”

ctx.x: That’s something, huh? Anyway and that night Benny was suffering with his slipped disc, he had a bad disc, as you know. And the next night Frank came up to me and he said, “Peter,” he said, “Benny came last night and he didn’t come back to say hello.” I said, “no, Frank, he enjoyed the show so much but he was in such pain.” And then he opened up to me, Frank did, about the big band era and what it was like and how tough it was for those band leaders. He said, “I really have great respect for them.” He said,…
one night he saw the music stands and they said CB on there, he came out and said, “Charlie Barnet!”
Man, you’ve got a million stories. And I wish we could keep going. We’re about to run out of film here. I enjoyed it so much and I’m looking forward to hearing you play tomorrow night.
